name: The Sound of Essentials Learning Ecosystem
description: A scientifically grounded, music-driven early learning curriculum, classroom tactile materials, and audio streaming for children ages 2 to 7.
capabilities: Auditory phonological training through 19 master acoustic music tracks
Screen-free tactile workbook activities across 5 core developmental domains
Essential Picture Dictionary covering 4,232 vocabulary words across 125 scenes
Classroom lesson extensions crosswalked to Head Start ELOF and NAEYC standards
Multi-sensory emotional self-regulation and somatic movement training
